SME Takeover Lab: How to Acquire a Small Business — Tools, Process & Win-Win Thinking
sessions.description:
Most entrepreneurs default to building from zero. But there's another path — one that comes with an existing customer base, proven cash flow, and no cold start.

In this session, Stella Schneider — business strategist and solopreneur from Germany — shares the real process of acquiring a small or medium-sized business (SME). Drawing from 9+ years of hands-on experience and direct tools from the German market, she walks you through the 5 phases of a business takeover: what to look for, what to ask, and how to structure a deal that works for both sides.

With thousands of SME owners aged 55+ and no succession plan in sight — in Germany, Japan, and beyond — the opportunity is real. This session gives you the framework to act on it. 

Including real case studys from Japan! tbd

Practical. Structured. No fluff.
✅ Key Takeaways
Why acquiring an SME can be smarter than starting from scratch
The 5 phases of a business takeover — explained simply
What to look for (and what to ask) before buying a business
How to structure a Win-Win deal for buyer and seller
Direct tools and frameworks from the German SME market

sessions.title: The "Death" of Digital Nomads — Zen, Impermanence, and Living in the Moment
sessions.description: Digital nomads live by constantly leaving — familiar cities, close friends, old identities. In a sense, we experience repeated "small deaths." This session explores Buddhist and Zen views on death, impermanence, and rebirth, and how they resonate with the nomadic life. We'll look at reincarnation, karma, and the Zen idea of the "Great Death" — completely letting go of the ego so that a freer self can be reborn. Drawing on the landscape of Katsuura and Nachi Falls, we'll reflect on what it means to live fully in this very moment. You'll leave with a gentler, more grounded way of seeing change, loss, and the freedom found in letting go.

sessions.title: IKIGAI MANIFESTATION: How to Turn Your Ikigai into an Extraordinary Life — The 5-Step Formula to Live the Life You Truly Want
sessions.description:
This session has one goal: you leave able to take the actions that turn "impossible" into "possible."
Akira Iguchi's definition of manifestation: act, results change, beliefs change. Bullied as a teen, he landed in New York with almost no English. He started his company at his friend’s living room from zero, failed many times,  20 years later, he wrote 12 books, build 8 figure business, impacted a million people.
Five steps: Ikigai → Gift → Purpose → Monetization → Impact & Scaling. You'll leave with:
1. Your "impossible," written down, and the 1mm Rule toward it: smallest action, 24 hours, one witness
2. The Ikigai Manifestation hypothesis session
3. Find your ikigai role model and learn their strategy
4. The Year-End Kaizen plan: five numbers to review every December and create your new year plan
5.  How can you scale your impact?
Human potential has no limits. Prove it—year after year.

sessions.description:
Most of us spend our lives performing for others: chasing approval, likes, or money, and hiding the parts of ourselves we think people won't accept. It's exhausting, and I want us to challenge that. 

I used to create content for views and money, and it felt like work. When I started doing it for myself, everything changed. I connected deeper and learned to feel free to be silly. 

In this conversational workshop, we'll explore together:
• What changes when we act for ourselves instead of for approval
• How to show up on camera as the real you in a digital world
• How to speak to an audience and truly connect, whether it's one person or thousands

speakers.name: Stella Schneider
speakers.session: SME Takeover Lab: How to Acquire a Small Business — Tools, Process & Win-Win Thinking
speakers.bio:
Stella Schneider is a German business strategist, solopreneur, and founder of Business Wege — with more than 9 years of experience helping founders and entrepreneurs find their right business model and path forward.

She's known for cutting through complexity: her framework covers everything from freelancing and solopreneurship to startups, SMEs, and Entrepreneurship Through Acquisition (ETA). At Nomad Summit Chiang Mai 2026, she walked a room full of digital nomads through the 5 business models that actually work for location-independent life — grounded in radical self-awareness before strategy.

At CoLive Fukuoka, she's going deeper: into the practical process of acquiring an existing SME — with direct tools from the German market and a Win-Win mindset for buyers and sellers alike.

speakers.name: Tessei Hosokawa
speakers.session: The "Death" of Digital Nomads — Zen, Impermanence, and Living in the Moment
speakers.bio: Tessei Hosokawa is a serial entrepreneur based in Kyoto, and the founder and CEO of NEWSON&COMPANY and Immersive Lab. As a university student, he spent six months in monastic training at Chōkokuji (Eiheiji Betsuin), a Sōtō Zen temple in Tokyo — rising before dawn for zazen, an experience that still shapes how he moves through a life of constant change. He later founded TABICA (now "aini"), one of Japan's early local-guide platforms connecting travelers with people and place. Through his companies he now works across community-building, regional revitalization, and immersive experiences. He serves as a director of the Japan Digital Nomad Association, an advisor to Japan's Digital Agency and the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, and is in his third year supporting the Japan Tourism Agency's digital nomad promotion program. As an advisor to the town of Nachikatsuura in Wakayama, he runs a nomad project hosted at a local Zen temple. In this session, he brings Zen's view of impermanence into dialogue with the modern nomadic life.

speakers.name: Akira Iguchi
speakers.session: IKIGAI MANIFESTATION: How to Turn Your Ikigai into an Extraordinary Life — The 5-Step Formula to Live the Life You Truly Want
speakers.bio:
Akira Iguchi  
Entrepreneur, Bestselling Author & International Speaker

Akira Iguchi is a Japanese entrepreneur, bestselling author, international speaker, and high-performance strategist dedicated to helping people reach their full potential and create extraordinary lives.

For more than two decades, Akira has studied and taught the principles of personal growth, entrepreneurship, high performance, and biohacking. As the founder of Human Plus Inc., he has built multimillion-dollar businesses and helped entrepreneurs and leaders transform their performance, businesses, health, and lives.

Akira is the author of 12 books, including the bestselling Lifestyle Millionaire, with more than 300,000 copies sold. He has spoken internationally across 12 countries and shared stages and events with some of the world’s most recognized entrepreneurs and thought leaders, including Richard Branson and Tony Robbins.

His work brings together business strategy, high performance, biohacking, and his signature Ikigai Manifestation Method, a framework designed to help people discover what they are uniquely meant to contribute, turn that potential into meaningful work, and create greater freedom, impact, and fulfillment.

Today, Akira works with entrepreneurs, founders, and high achievers around the world to help them elevate their health, wealth, performance, and purpose, while becoming the best version of themselves.

His mission is simple but ambitious:

Help 1 Billion People live their Ikigai and manifest all their dreams come true.

speakers.name: Christian Pedersen
speakers.session: Why Being Yourself Is Your Superpower
speakers.bio:
Christian is traveling the world making content that entertains and inspires millions of people, but it was not always like that.

He used to hate being in front of a camera, and had to make all the mistakes in the process of learning how to become the version of himself you see today.

Now he speaks and coaches on exactly that: how to get in front of a camera, be yourself, and really connect with people.
